name: Omarchy Super Switcher
author: jfdnet
description: All-in-one window management for Omarchy: fast Alt+Tab (Orbit) with maximized landings, workspace numbers on the bar, live overview (Super+Tab), gesture-driven Workspace Gallery (Super+A), and smart gaps (single tiled window = no gaps/border).

barWidget.description: Workspace buttons, live overview, and visual window switching.
